description: This Java class 'RequestDefinitionSerializer' handles serialization and deserialization of RequestDefinition objects, including HttpRequest and OpenAPIDefinition types, to and from JSON format within the mockserver project.

classes.name: RequestDefinitionSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for converting RequestDefinition objects to and from JSON, supporting HttpRequest and OpenAPIDefinition types.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a RequestDefinition object to JSON, with optional pretty printing.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a RequestDefinition object, validating against JSON schema.

methods.name: deserializeArray
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON array string into an array of RequestDefinition objects.

methods.name: supportsType
methods.description: Returns the class type supported by this serializer, which is RequestDefinition.
